rows.figure: 15 unintentional drowning deaths (ICD-10 W65-W74), crude rate 1.1 per 100,000
rows.scope: Residents of Maine, deaths in 2018, underlying cause ICD-10 W65, W66, W67, W68, W69, W70, W73 or W74 (accidental drowning); excludes watercraft drowning (V90, V92), suicide (X71), homicide and undetermined intent (Y21). Population 1,338,404.
rows.source: CDC WONDER, Underlying Cause of Death, 2018-2024, Single Race (dataset D158), query by State and Year run 21 Oct 2026
rows.do_not_add_to: Unintentional W65-W74 only, by residence: not comparable with the state medical examiner's all-manner drowning counts and never added to them, to boating counts or to other years.
rows.note: No cell suppressed (every count is 10 or more). Watercraft drownings (V90, V92) by state and year would fall under WONDER's suppression threshold and were not queried.

tried: Query settings: Group By State then Year; States Maine and New Hampshire; Year all (2018-2024); ICD-10 codes W65-W70, W73, W74; totals and zero values shown; rates per 100,000. The data-use terms were accepted by the lab's owner for this session.
notes: Official yearly counts from death certificates, 2018-2024. They differ in definition from the state medical examiner counts in the companion bundle (all manners, case-based): for 2022-2024 the OCME prints 31, 31, 26 against 22, 15, 21 here; both are kept, never reconciled by the lab. No place or activity split: W69/W70 (natural water) by state and year fall below the suppression threshold in most years.
